title: Thrown motorcycle rider hits scenery
summary: The rider thrown in a motorcycle crash now collides with trees, props, the train and his own bike, not just terrain. ATV ragdoll is unchanged.
details: The rider reuses the bike's per-frame scenery mesh selection, widened to reach him within 40 ft. PR #753 (merge 87610b40), closes #751. Verification: 4 new ragdoll unit tests and 841 atv-core lib tests pass; content test thrown_rider.rs stopped the rider short of 8/8 ENV01 trees versus terrain-only; browser test test_engine_motorcycle_rider_scene.mjs passed on the PR CI build.
limitation: A fast limb can still clip a branch it grazes; no scenery collision beyond 40 ft from the bike; bike collision shapes are hand-estimated; host only, not phone-measured.
